tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa bzhugs so//

sangs rgyas chos tshogs bcas la skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun sgrol slad byang chub mchog sems bskyed// bdag nyid tha mal gnas pa'i mdun gyi mkhar// gyad dang seṅge padma nyi ma'i steng*// rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// sku mdog dkar dmar rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dge slong cha lugs bka' rtags sgom zhwa bgyid// phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon g.yon dril bu// lte 'og mnyam bzhag 'od zer tshad med 'phro// sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs kyis bskor// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// mos blo sgo gsum dang bas bstod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan bla ma rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso// chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam rgyal sde'i// zhabs la gsol 'debs dus kun thugs rjes gzigs// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe nad gdon bgegs// 'gal rkyen thams cad myur du zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas bzhin du// bsam don ma lus myur du 'grub gyur nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dgyes bzhin 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim zhing*/ */gtso bo 'od kyi phung por rab zhu nas// bdag gi spyi bor thim pas sgo gsum gyi// sgrib sbyangs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang*// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gyur// chos kun mi dmigs rang babs gshis su bskyangs// dge bas rigs drug mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god phyir bsngo// zhes pa khams skyo bla ma rin chen lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas| rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
